_comment: Battle skill and buff ids are <heroId><slot><level>[<n>] (e.g. 401424 = hero 4014, slot 2, level 4; buff 40142301 = slot 2). Slots are the client's hero_detail skill keys (5 = basic attack, 6 = relic) and do not follow the site's skill_1..4 order, so each hero is mapped from battle evidence.

4014.evidence: fights 2026-10-30 Odyssey 50-42: slot 2 fires once at ~3 s and buffs the back-line enemies; slot 1 starts only at full Energy and repeats; slot 3 hits the approaching melee enemy; slot 4 is a self buff refreshed on every slot-1 start.
